proposed_core_edits.reason: The negative identification certificate is a delivered root result, not a supporting lemma. The replacement proposition preserves and strengthens the explicit certificate to every deterministic dose. The immutable snapshot shows no inbound statement dependency on the obsolete lemma, so this promotion does not insert the proposition into any spatial-clock or other observed-law statistical result.

proposed_core_edits.proposed: The statistical target is the observed-law curve \(\theta(a)=\int m(a,w)p(w)\,dw\) for \(a\in J\). Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\) proves that the frozen model admits two admissible full-data extensions of the same observed law with different values of \(\mathbb E[Y(a)]\) at every deterministic dose. Thus \(\theta(a)\) is not identified with an exact-dose causal mean without an additional causal bridge.
proposed_core_edits.reason: The estimand line must cite the promoted root certificate and must distinguish the observed-law functional from the unidentifiable exact-dose causal mean.

prose_updates.tldr: Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\) proves, by two explicit random-diagonal full-data extensions of one observed law, that the frozen assumptions do not identify \(\mathbb E[Y(a)]\) at any deterministic dose. The paper therefore targets only the observed-law curve \(\theta(a)=\int m(a,w)p(w)\,dw\). On the likelihood-ratio side, the proved content is fixed-location finite-dimensional stationarity; exact Brownian scaling, which by itself gives no large-deviation principle or tail law; the proved deterministic action bracket \(1/2\le I_\star\le9/8\) with its single-plateau witness; the exact spatial-volume clock; centering algebra conditional on a future excursion expansion; and deterministic profile inversion. The contact-set analysis is an aspirational open-problem program, not a calibrated simultaneous causal band or a validated Gumbel procedure.

project_justification.gap: Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\) gives a constructive obstruction to causal interpretation: sectionwise exchangeability and a continuous conditional potential-outcome mean version permit random-diagonal changes that preserve the observed law and consistency while changing every deterministic-dose mean. Independently, Banerjee and Wellner (2001) provide only the fixed-location Brownian--GCM likelihood-ratio functional. Hooghiemstra and Lopuhaä (1998) rely on an explicit Markov argmax jump process, and Durot, Kulikov, and Lopuhaä (2012) transfer slope-error extremes through that process; neither result supplies an extreme-value theorem for the nonlocal likelihood-ratio energy.
project_justification.niche: The current contribution is a negative exact-dose identification certificate together with deterministic and fixed-location likelihood-ratio structure. A future research program could add a valid causal bridge and develop an infinite-domain GCM contact-set large-deviation principle, minimizer classification, sharp Palm expansion, anticlustering, marked-Poisson approximation, and a continuum-grid theorem. That program is aspirational and none of its probability conclusions is claimed here.
project_justification.fill: The completed results are Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\), fixed-location finite-dimensional stationarity, exact Brownian/GCM dilation, the proved deterministic bracket \(1/2\le I_\star\le9/8\), optimality of \(9/8\) within the full single-plateau family through minimization of \((1+r)^3/(6r)\) at \(r=1/2\), the explicit plateau witness, the exact observed-law spatial-volume clock, centering substitution conditional on a future affine-log excursion expansion, deterministic profile interval and image-set properties, and homogeneous reduction. No nuisance-rate theorem, optimized primitive-to-likelihood-ratio transfer theorem, tail rate, critical value, Poisson law, Gumbel law, simulation guarantee, or coverage theorem is retained.

sampling_model.design: The observed sample is iid from \(P\in\mathcal M\). Membership requires at least one full-data extension satisfying consistency, sectionwise conditional exchangeability, and conditional-potential-mean continuity, but Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\) proves that two admissible extensions of the same observed law may disagree on \(\mathbb E[Y(a)]\) for every deterministic dose.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The cross-fitted primitive remains an observed-law construction, but no standalone learner-rate or optimized primitive-to-likelihood-ratio transfer theorem is retained. In particular, the present results do not establish a fitted-kernel maximal inequality, common contact localization, a slope envelope, or uniform stability of optimized likelihood-ratio values.

prose_updates.related_work: Banerjee and Wellner (2001) are used only for the finite fixed-location Brownian--GCM likelihood-ratio functional. Hooghiemstra and Lopuhaä (1998) derive extremes for a distinct Markov argmax process using its jump-transition machinery; Durot, Kulikov, and Lopuhaä (2012) transfer slope-error extremes through that argmax process, not likelihood-ratio-energy excursions. Doss (2026) supplies neighboring fixed-dose causal-isotonic likelihood-ratio work, while Takatsu and Westling (2025), Ai, Huang, and Zhang (2026), and Doss--VandenBerg supply neighboring simultaneous-band methods. None of those results is imported as a tail theorem for the nonlocal likelihood-ratio energy, and the present paper claims neither sharper bands, optimal width, tuning freedom, nor dominance over the Doss--VandenBerg multiscale Gaussian bands.
prose_updates.interpretation: The estimand \(\theta(a)=\int m(a,w)p(w)\,dw\) is an observed-law G-computation curve on \(J\), not an identified exact-dose causal curve: Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\) supplies two admissible extensions with different deterministic-dose means. For the AHA/CMS nurse-hours--readmission application, the current mathematics supports only an observed-law isotonic likelihood-ratio profile and the deterministic profile image set induced by an arbitrary common threshold. It does not support calibrated simultaneous causal reporting, a nominal confidence set for a threshold-crossing dose, or a Gumbel critical value.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: Exact Brownian scaling gives \(\Pr\{D(0)>u\}=\Pr\{\Phi(u^{-1/2}\mathbb W)>1\}\), but no infinite-domain large-deviation principle or probability-tail conclusion follows from that identity. The proved deterministic action satisfies \(1/2\le I_\star\le9/8\), and the plateau value \(9/8\) is optimal only within the complete single-plateau family because \((1+r)^3/(6r)\) is minimized at \(r=1/2\). Missing probability ingredients are contact-set exponential tightness and continuity, global action-minimizer classification and uniqueness modulo translation, sharp Palm fluctuation and multiplicity analysis, conditional cluster-shape control, short-range anticlustering, marked-Poisson approximation, and a sample-path modulus/grid theorem. Separately, optimized observed-statistic transfer lacks the fitted-kernel maximal inequality, common localization, and slope-envelope arguments; no orphan nuisance-rate or transfer claim substitutes for those proofs.
prose_updates.honest_scope: Proposition \(\texttt{prop:exact-dose-nonidentification}\) proves that exact-dose causal identification fails under the frozen assumptions. The surviving positive results do not include a likelihood-ratio-energy tail rate, growing-domain coupling, critical value, feasible calibration, simulated-grid approximation, Poisson or Gumbel limit, or nominal simultaneous coverage theorem. The exact scaling identity carries no large-deviation or tail implication; the action bracket is deterministic; and the contact-set program is an aspirational open question not consumed by a proved theorem. The AHA/CMS output is therefore an observed-law profile and profile image set only. No claim is made about optimal width, tuning freedom, or dominance over the Doss--VandenBerg multiscale Gaussian bands.

statement_notes.justification: This root proposition is the paper's constructive negative certificate: two fully verified full-data extensions of one smooth, strictly increasing observed law disagree on every deterministic-dose causal mean.
statement_notes.gap: Sectionwise exchangeability and continuity of conditional potential-outcome mean versions do not constrain modifications supported on the random diagonal \(a=A\), although realized-dose consistency evaluates that diagonal.
statement_notes.consumer: The AHA/CMS nurse-hours--readmission analysis must describe \(\theta\) and its likelihood-ratio profile as observed-law objects until a separate causal bridge rules out the certified random-diagonal ambiguity.

statement_notes.justification: The proposition locates \(\mathcal M\) as a nonempty proper smooth observed-law subclass of the published causal-isotonic model; it does not support an excursion-transfer or simultaneous-calibration theorem.
statement_notes.gap: The fixed-radius Hölder, strict-slope, bounded-density, and effective-variance restrictions are additional instrumental conditions, not conclusions imported from the broader published model.
statement_notes.consumer: Readers may use the inclusion only to scope the observed-law deterministic and fixed-location results; it does not certify a calibrated band for the broader model or for \(\mathcal M\).

statement_notes.justification: Despite its historical identifier, this theorem is the exact observed-law spatial-clock identity and its uniform positivity bounds.
statement_notes.gap: It proves no coupling between the sample likelihood-ratio supremum and a canonical growing-domain maximum, and it contains no primitive-to-likelihood-ratio transfer conclusion.
statement_notes.consumer: The clock is a deterministic coordinate for future analysis, not an observed-statistic limit theorem, critical value, or causal-transfer theorem.

statement_notes.justification: Despite its historical identifier, this theorem supplies clock-volume bounds and a centering-substitution calculation conditional on a future affine-log excursion expansion and relative clock consistency.
statement_notes.gap: Neither the postulated excursion expansion nor clock estimation, optimized-statistic transfer, a random-grid theorem, or anti-concentration is established.
statement_notes.consumer: The result is conditional centering calculus only; it yields no feasible critical value, calibration algorithm, Gumbel limit, or coverage statement.

statement_notes.justification: The proposition proves deterministic convex interval structure, common-event equivalence, and containment for the induced profile image set.
statement_notes.gap: Deterministic inversion does not determine the probability of the common likelihood-ratio event because no calibrated threshold is available.
statement_notes.consumer: An arbitrary threshold can be mapped into an observed-law profile and profile image set, but neither object is a nominal confidence band or threshold-crossing confidence set.
